content_sections.heading: About IISER Kolkata Project
content_sections.text: The position is part of a DST-funded project run jointly by the Department of Chemical Sciences and the Department of Biological Sciences at IISER Kolkata, Mohanpur, Nadia. The Principal Investigator is Prof. Alkesh Bisai and the Co-Principal Investigator is Prof. Amirul Mallick. The project is titled "Structure-Activity on Designing Novel Ionizable LNPs for mRNA Delivery".

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The essential qualification is a Doctoral Degree in Life Sciences or a relevant discipline from a recognized University. The upper age limit is 35 years, with age relaxation for reserved and other categories as per Government of India rules. The notice prints no age cut-off date. Prior experience in ex vivo and in vivo research, particularly in infectious diseases, is preferred. Experience in molecular cloning, recombinant DNA techniques, microbiological and cell culture techniques, and immunological assays is desirable. Candidates with experience in in vitro mRNA synthesis, transfection, and delivery will be given preference. Evidence of publications in peer-reviewed journals and good scientific writing skills are also desirable. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay is Rs. 58,000/- + 30% HRA per month (as per rules). The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project duration. The initial appointment is for 1 year and is extendable for a maximum of 2 years, based on satisfactory performance and availability of funds. The start date of the position is the third week of December 2026.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISER Kolkata Research Associate- I
content_sections.text: Prepare a cover letter, a detailed CV, and work experience details, if any. Combine them in a single PDF. Email the PDF to [email protected] .
